text:
maya: Heads up — quantized-v0.3 eval CI is failing for perf-runner. p95 latency doubled and cost/token jumped on the CI run. Anyone seen this pattern?

david: I noticed some errors earlier. Logs show the runner sometimes reports token_count=0 for a few requests, which makes our cost calc look inflated. Can you paste the failing log chunk?

eval-bot: CI job: https://ci.internal/redwood/quantized-v0.3/build/4593 — failing tests: perf/runner-p95, metrics/consistency

maya: Here's the snippet from the failing job (sanitized):
```
INFO 2026-02-14T12:10:03Z runner: request_id=xyz partial_response=true emitted_tokens=1200 token_count=0
WARN 2026-02-14T12:10:03Z metrics: aggregate_event dropped: missing_token_count
INFO 2026-02-14T12:10:04Z runner: completed request_id=xyz duration_ms=42
```

ashley: That 'partial_response' + token_count=0 combo is suspicious. Our aggregator expects a token_count field for every response event. In quant path we changed the emitter to stream tokens as separate events (no eos), so the metrics consumer might be losing them.

sergey: I reproduced locally with a concurrency sweep. When concurrency > 8 and batching merges partials, the aggregator sees events out of order and the reducer overwrites token_count with 0 for some request IDs. Looks like a race in metrics-mapper map_by_request_id() where last write wins.

david: Good catch. Also found we're using 'token_count' in the dashboard to compute cost/token but the eval harness produces 'decoded_tokens'. We never mapped decoded_tokens -> token_count for quantized models. That explains the cost spike and the apparent p95 regression.

maya: Plan: (1) short-term fix in metrics-mapper to sum partial emitted_tokens and avoid overwriting with 0, add test; (2) update eval-harness mapping to prefer decoded_tokens if present; (3) change CI perf test to sample p95 over a 30s window instead of a single point. I'll open PRs now.

maya: PRs:
- https://git.redwood/eng/metrics-mapper/pull/112 (fix: sum partials, add concurrency repro)
- https://git.redwood/eng/eval-harness/pull/89 (map decoded_tokens -> token_count for quantized models)

ci-bot: Created ticket RED-INV-321 to track: Quant-v0.3 CI metrics mismatch (assignee: maya)

ashley: Also update the perf dashboard legend to show both token_count and decoded_tokens for a while so we can compare. Add an alert if token_count / decoded_tokens > 1.5.

david: I'll change the CI job to run the p95 aggregator over the last 30s sliding window and post the updated harness config in the PR.

sergey: I pushed a small unit test that simulates interleaved partial events. It fails on master, passes with metrics-mapper#112. Local run: `pytest tests/test_partial_events.py::test_interleaved_partials -k 1` -> passed.

maya: Re-running CI after merging metrics-mapper#112 and eval-harness#89.

ci-bot: CI build 4594 queued...

ci-bot: CI build 4594 succeeded — perf/runner-p95 within SLO, metrics consistency checks passed. :tada:

maya: Nice — leaving RED-INV-321 open for dashboard follow-ups and a 1-week monitoring check. Thanks everyone :+1!
